# table

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/table"
```

Package table sizes columns to their contents, giving way in a declared order when even that is too wide, and lays cells out in them. Model adds a cursor over the rows, which scroll under a fixed header.

## Constants

<a name="Gap"></a>Gap is the columns between cells.

```go
const Gap = 2
```

<a name="Contains"></a>
## func [Contains](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/filter.go#L17>)

```go
func Contains(query, text string) bool
```

Contains is the filter's default match: the row's text holds the query, in any case.

<a name="Fit"></a>
## func [Fit](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L27>)

```go
func Fit(cols []Column, rows [][]string, width int) []int
```

Fit returns each column's width: its widest cell \(title included\) capped at Max, then shrunk to fit width \- Flex first down to Min, then the widest, never below minCell. Min is a floor for shrinking, not a width to grow to.

<a name="Natural"></a>
## func [Natural](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/sort.go#L23>)

```go
func Natural(a, b string) bool
```

Natural is the default order of a column: the cells' text, colours stripped and in any case, with each run of digits compared as a number, so v1.4 comes before v1.11 and 9 before 10.

<a name="Row"></a>
## func [Row](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L95>)

```go
func Row(widths []int, cells []string) string
```

Row lays cells out in widths, padded to their columns and separated by Gap; the last cell is cut but not padded, so the row ends where it ends. A line break in a cell is a space: a row is one line.

<a name="Static"></a>
## func [Static](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/static.go#L11>)

```go
func Static(cols []Column, rows [][]string, width int, th theme.Resolved) string
```

Static is the whole table as text to print, the header on top: no cursor, no scrolling. Columns fit width as in Fit; width \<= 0 keeps their own.

<a name="Titles"></a>
## func [Titles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L112>)

```go
func Titles(cols []Column, widths []int) string
```

Titles is the header row: every column's title in its width.

<a name="Chosen"></a>
## type [Chosen](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/events.go#L6>)

Chosen is the event of a row being chosen: enter, or a click on the row already under the cursor. Item is a copy of that row; the Model's Column says which cell while it is WithCells.

```go
type Chosen[T any] struct{ Item Item[T] }
```

<a name="Column"></a>
## type [Column](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/table.go#L15-L19>)

Column declares one column; Min and Max bound its width \(0 = unbounded\). Flex marks the column that shrinks first: a truncated name is still recognisable, a truncated version is not.

```go
type Column struct {
    Title    string
    Min, Max int
    Flex     bool
}
```

<a name="Item"></a>
## type [Item](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L25-L30>)

Item is one row of a Model: its cells in column order, and a payload of the caller's type T. A cell may carry its own colour. A Busy row shows a turning spinner where the cursor's marker goes.

```go
type Item[T any] struct {
    Cells   []string
    Value   T
    Busy    bool
    Checked bool // ticked for a batch, while the table is WithMulti
}
```

<a name="FromValues"></a>
### func [FromValues](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L193>)

```go
func FromValues[T any](text, sep string) []Item[T]
```

FromValues is the rows of delimited text, one per line, its cells split at sep; blank lines are skipped. The payload is left zero.

<a name="Keys"></a>
## type [Keys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L33-L39>)

Keys are the bindings the table answers to.

```go
type Keys struct {
    Up, Down, PageUp, PageDown, HalfPageUp, HalfPageDown, Top, Bottom, Enter, Filter, Esc key.Binding
    Erase                                                                                 key.Binding // the filter's last character
    Check, CheckAll                                                                       key.Binding // while WithMulti
    Sort                                                                                  key.Binding
    Left, Right                                                                           key.Binding // between cells, while WithCells
}
```

<a name="DefaultKeys"></a>
### func [DefaultKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L44>)

```go
func DefaultKeys() Keys
```

DefaultKeys are the arrows, pgup/pgdown, ctrl\+u/ctrl\+d for half a page, home/end, enter, / and esc, ctrl\+s to sort; space and ctrl\+a check rows while WithMulti, and ←/→ move between cells while WithCells.

<a name="VimKeys"></a>
### func [VimKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L68>)

```go
func VimKeys() Keys
```

VimKeys are DefaultKeys with vim's letters added: k/j to move, h/l between cells, g/G to the ends and ctrl\+b/f to page. The filter still takes text.




<a name="Model[T].Update"></a>
### func \(Model\[T\]\) [Update](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L275>)

```go
func (m Model[T]) Update(msg tea.Msg) (Model[T], bezel.Result)
```

Update takes the table's keys unless blurred, a bezel.ClickMsg on a row and the Busy spinner's frames. Choosing a row reports a [Chosen](<#Chosen>), checking one a [Toggled](<#Toggled>), sorting a [Sorted](<#Sorted>); any other message comes back unhandled.

<a name="Model[T].View"></a>
### func \(Model\[T\]\) [View](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L455>)

```go
func (m Model[T]) View(th theme.Resolved) string
```

View is the header and the rows in its window, SetWidth cells wide, and nothing until SetHeight and SetWidth size it. Columns are sized over every row, so scrolling never moves them; a plain cell wears the cursor's colour.

<a name="Sorted"></a>
## type [Sorted](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/events.go#L14-L17>)

Sorted is the event of the rows sorted again: Sort, or a click on a column's title, which sorts by it and then the other way.

```go
type Sorted struct {
    Column int
    Desc   bool
}
```

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L107-L116>)

Styles are how a table paints its parts.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Header  lipgloss.Style // the column titles
    Cursor  lipgloss.Style // the cursor row's marker and its plain cells
    Blurred lipgloss.Style // the cursor row's marker while the table is blurred
    More    lipgloss.Style // the "↓ N more" row
    Busy    lipgloss.Style // the spinner on a Busy row
    Box     lipgloss.Style // an unchecked row's box while WithMulti
    Checked lipgloss.Style // a checked row's box
    Cell    lipgloss.Style // the cell under the cursor while WithCells
}
```

<a name="DefaultStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/model.go#L121>)

```go
func DefaultStyles(th theme.Resolved) Styles
```

DefaultStyles take the header from the theme's table role, paint the cursor row in the cursor role and its cell as the caret, a busy row's spinner and a checked box in the accent and an empty box muted.

<a name="Toggled"></a>
## type [Toggled](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/table/events.go#L10>)

Toggled is the event of rows checked or unchecked while the table is WithMulti: one row for Check, every one that changed for CheckAll.

```go
type Toggled[T any] struct{ Items []Item[T] }
```
